Desk cover, a friendly update midweek
We write to travelers

Travel Notice for Companion Animal Travel Desk

Travelers with companion animals should review their arrangements before arrival so handoff at Aurelia Skyways stays smooth. Our ground team moves carriers carefully between services, and we work to keep each journey calm and orderly for pets and people alike.

<<FACT F019>> Please keep documents ready, follow staff directions, and use the marked areas for check-in and comfort breaks. Clear labeling and steady handling help reduce delays and support a safer trip for every animal in our care.

<<FACT F006>> If you are connecting onward, please confirm your transfer details with the desk so we can guide you through the next steps. We are here to help with carrier checks, route notes, and any practical concerns that arise before departure.

<<FACT F017>> For any remaining questions about pet travel, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before you proceed to the gate. We will do our best to help with a calm and dependable service.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
